criteria.text: Subscribe AgentRunner-created sessions to the SAME bridge at creation (after `setSdkSessionId`), so parts/status stream into the DB + WS as they happen and the open view renders them live — one rendering path across the board. Directory-scoping: the bridge subscription must use the run's `effectiveCwd` (#1002).
criteria.test_id: issue-1040-c1: subscribes a headless run to the shared stream bridge with effectiveCwd

criteria.text: Double-persistence: AgentRunner appends the final output at completion; the bridge persists parts as they stream. Dedupe (e.g. via `sdk_message_id`) or skip AgentRunner's final append when the bridge streamed the turn.
criteria.test_id: issue-1040-c2: completion upsert does not duplicate an assistant message already persisted by the bridge

criteria.text: Live: trigger a scheduled research run, open its session while running → tool calls/text stream in as they happen; final state matches today's persisted transcript. No duplicate messages. Interactive chats unchanged.
criteria.reason: Requires the real running Rhythm app and engine; this run is explicitly limited to tsc + vitest and must not spawn or replace the processes owning :4001/:4096.
